title: ReviewLane
description: Schema for a single review lane in the Thermos review process.

lane_id.description: The identifier for the review lane, e.g., 'A' or 'B'.

status.description: The overall status of the review lane.

findings.description: A list of findings discovered during the review.

file_path.description: The path to the file where the finding was made.

line_number.description: The line number of the finding.

rubric_item.description: For Lane B, the rubric item this finding relates to.

rubric_checklist.description: For Lane B, the checklist of rubric items and their status.
